source_text: Ὡσαύτως καὶ αἱ τρεῖς ἡμέραι πρὸ τῶν φωστήρων γεγονυῖαι τύποι εἰσὶν τῆς τριάδος, τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τοῦ λόγου αὐτοῦ καὶ τῆς σοφίας αὐτοῦ. Τετάρτῳ δὲ τύπῳ ἐστὶν ἄνθρωπος ὁ προσδεὴς τοῦ φωτός, ἵνα ᾖ θεός, λόγος, σοφία, ἄνθρωπος.
pass_a_gloss: Similarly also the three days which have come into being before the lights are types of the trinity, of God and of His Word and of His Wisdom. On the fourth day the man is the type who has need of the light, so that he may be God, Word, Wisdom, man.

choices.english: the man who has need of the light
on the fourth day the type

pass_b_english: Likewise, the three days that existed before the lights are types of the Trinity — God, His Word, and His Wisdom. On the fourth day, the man who needs the light is the type, so that he may be God, Word, Wisdom, and man.
